title: The exact factor-of-IID threshold for free Ising spins on trees

result.label: The exact factor-of-IID threshold for free Ising spins on trees
result.statement: Determines when the free zero-field ferromagnetic Ising state on the infinite d -regular tree is a factor of independent vertex labels: exactly when (d-1)^ -1/2 , including equality, for d ≥ 3 and β ≥ 0. The construction uses no root and is almost surely equivariant for each fixed tree automorphism, resolving the ferromagnetic case of Lyons's question.
